item.title: Woman killed in crash with Tesla near Dunlap identified
item.description: Authorities have identified 34-year-old Misty Lynn as the woman killed in a DUI crash in Fresno County, which also involved two small children.

item.title: Murder trial begins for accused Fresno drunk driver
item.description: An accused drunk driver appeared in court for a murder trial on Thursday.

item.title: ABC30 to co-host California gubernatorial debate on March 24
item.description: ABC30 will co-host a gubernatorial debate on Tuesday, March 24.

item.title: Dine and Dish: Toledo's Mexican Restaurant
item.description: When Sam Toledo opened his first Toledo's restaurant in 1991, he had no idea he would need more locations so people could enjoy his heavenly creations.

item.title: Wild Water Adventure Park unveils new attraction's official name
item.description: The long-awaited lazy river at Wild Water Adventure Park is moving closer to completion.

item.title: Trump administration sues California over state's nation-leading vehicle-emission rules
item.description: The Trump administration ramped up a battle with California over the state's nation-leading vehicle-emission standards Thursday, suing air regulators over rules aimed at curbing pollution from cars.

item.title: Deputies, suspect, and PG&E employee wounded during shooting in El Dorado County
item.description: A PG&E crew reported being shot at early Thursday morning at a residence, prompting a response from the El Dorado County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: 1 person found shot near VA hospital in central Fresno, police say
item.description: Several streets have been blocked off as police search for the suspects involved in a shooting at the entrance of the VA hospital in central Fresno.

item.title: Charges filed against woman accused of deadly hit and run crash in Parlier
item.description: Charges have been filed against 35-year-old Tiffany Mercado, the woman accused of hitting and killing 15-year-old Juliani Moreno in Parlier Tuesday night.

item.title: Rising prices of fertilizer raise concerns for Valley farmers amid Iran war
item.description: Global fertilizer shipments through the Strait of Hormuz face disruption, pushing prices higher and raising concerns for Central Valley farmers.
